question: Will India qualify for the WTC 2027 Final?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if India finishes in the top two of the ICC World Test Championship (WTC) 2025–27 cycle final standings by Points Percentage (PCT) at the conclusion of the league stage, thereby qualifying for the WTC 2027 Final.
- "No": Wins if India finishes third or lower in the ICC WTC 2025–27 cycle final standings by PCT at the conclusion of the league stage, failing to qualify for the WTC 2027 Final.

Clarifications:
- The qualifying metric is the official ICC Points Percentage (PCT) — total points earned divided by total points available, multiplied by 100 — as published in the official ICC WTC 2025–27 standings at the close of the league stage. If two or more teams are level on PCT, the ICC's official published tie-breaking order (as applied in the final ICC standings) determines their relative placement.
